_doc: Written by tools/states-scout/build.py; refresh with fetch.py --refetch, analyze.py, build.py. tipRate is the team's own AUTO TIPs per match, a least-squares share of its alliances' TIPs (FTCScout scores TIPs per alliance). likelySide/sideConfidence: seen on video = high; otherwise from the archetype (LEAVE-PARK: LEFT, medium; RIGHT-SHOOT-PARK: RIGHT, medium if tipRate 0.6+, else low). shoots: hits (own TIP rate 0.6+), misses (it tips, under 0.6) or none; lastShotS: its last preload, from video. Archetype names are the partner reality-check chat's. leave/park are its own, per robot, all season; *Recent are its last event. allianceAuto is its alliance's AUTO points (best/median/worst).
rule: R-Solo beside every partner (it starts LEFT, is off its start by 8 s, never stops along the scoring-table wall, parks in the LOADING ZONE corner at the scoring-table end); L-NoCross only beside a partner seen on video starting RIGHT and tipping. Mentor, 26 Nov 2026.

init: Partner starts LEFT, is off its start by 8 s, does not stop along the scoring-table wall, and parks in the corner at the scoring-table end of the LOADING ZONE
If they must park mid-zone: note it and tell the mentor (R-Solo-LowPark, #763, a draft, may run instead)
R-Solo: nothing else to set
Endgame: PARK FIRST (quals); TIPS FIRST in playoffs only if our shots land
ask: Start LEFT. Be off your start by 8 seconds. Don't stop along the scoring-table wall. Park at the scoring-table end of the LOADING ZONE, in the corner.
Does your Auto LEAVE and PARK every time?
Where do you park, and by when?
R-SOLO.sim: Beside a LEAVE-PARK partner 36 pts, 0 contacts (needs #759 on the robot). Why the ask: a partner leaving at 9 s is hit at 10.5 s; one stopping a tile along the scoring-table wall is hit at 10.9 s; one still in the LOADING ZONE touches our RIGHT_PARK.
R-SOLO.why: Default: not seen on video starting RIGHT and tipping.

init: Wait: as drawn, "waiting for TIP 1 until 9 s"
if no TIP 1: CROSS AND FIX IT only if they promise to drive off their start before 10 s, or stay on it until 16 s, when their preloads miss; otherwise WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX
Endgame: PARK FIRST (quals); TIPS FIRST in playoffs only if our shots land
ask: If your preloads miss, do you drive off your start before 10 s, or stay on it until 16 s?
If your preloads miss, do you shoot at that CELL again?
Where do you park, and by when?
L-NOCROSS.sim: 40 pts when they hit, 28 when they miss. Our cross is in the right lane about 9-15.3 s; a partner leaving RIGHT_START at 10.3-16 s hits us.
L-NOCROSS.why: Seen on video starting RIGHT and tipping.

init: Wait: as drawn, "waiting for TIP 1 until 9 s"
if no TIP 1: WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX (never cross: it sits on our right launch spot)
Endgame: PARK FIRST
ask: Which side do you start, and do you shoot your preloads right at the start?
Where do you park, and by when?
L-NOCROSS-WAIT.why: Exception: it waits on RIGHT_AUTO_HIVE 7-19 s, so no R- Auto beside it.

init: Partner starts LEFT and shoots at the LEFT CELL after our TIP 1
if no TIP 2: WAIT FOR PARTNER (default)
Endgame: PARK FIRST (quals); TIPS FIRST in playoffs only if our shots land
ask: Will you start LEFT and shoot at the LEFT CELL?
Where do you park, and by when?
R-NOCROSS.sim: 40 pts, no contact beside a left shooter; 3 of 3 on video, no contact.
R-NOCROSS.why: Exception: a left shooter (seen on video beside our R-NoCross).

RIGHT-SHOOT-PARK.label: RIGHT-SHOOT-PARK
init: Wait: as drawn, "waiting for TIP 1 until 9 s"
if no TIP 1: CROSS AND FIX IT only if they promise to drive off their start before 10 s, or stay on it until 16 s, when their preloads miss; otherwise WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX
Endgame: PARK FIRST (quals); TIPS FIRST in playoffs only if our shots land
ask: Which side do you start, and do you shoot your preloads right at the start?
If your preloads miss, do you drive off your start before 10 s, or stay on it until 16 s?
If your preloads miss, do you shoot at that CELL again?
Where do you park, and by when?
RIGHT-SHOOT-PARK.sim: 40 pts when they hit, 28 when they miss (reality-check sims, 26 Nov 2026).
RIGHT-SHOOT-PARK.watch: CROSS AND FIX IT puts us in the right lane from about 9 to 15.3 s: a partner leaving RIGHT_START between about 10.3 and 16 s hits us. Raising our partner wait moves that window later by the same amount.

LEFT-SHOOT-PARK.label: LEFT-SHOOT-PARK
init: Wait: nothing to set (our preloads make TIP 1; they shoot after it)
if no TIP 2: WAIT FOR PARTNER (default)
Endgame: PARK FIRST (quals); TIPS FIRST in playoffs only if our shots land
ask: Which side do you start, and do you shoot your preloads right at the start?
Do you wait for the LEFT CELL to come up before you shoot?
Where do you park, and by when?
LEFT-SHOOT-PARK.watch: Their CELL is down until our TIP 1, so their shot depends on ours.

LEAVE-PARK.label: LEAVE-PARK
init: R-Solo: nothing to set
R-NoCross: if no TIP 2: CROSS AND FIX IT (36 pts, no contact beside a LEAVE-PARK partner)
Endgame: PARK FIRST (their park is our SWARM)
ask: Which side do you start, and do you shoot your preloads right at the start?
Does your Auto LEAVE and PARK every time?
Where do you park, and by when?
LEAVE-PARK.sim: R-Solo 36 pts, 0 contacts (with #759). R-NoCross on CROSS AND FIX IT 36 pts, no contact.
LEAVE-PARK.watch: SWARM needs their LEAVE and PARK too.

STILL.label: STILL
init: R-NoCross: if no TIP 2: CROSS AND FIX IT (28 pts, no contact beside a partner in the corner)
Endgame: PARK FIRST
ask: Do you have an Auto at all?
If you won't move, sit in the corner past the LOADING ZONE tape.
STILL.sim: In the corner: R-NoCross on CROSS AND FIX IT 28 pts, no contact. In the LOADING ZONE: 33 pts, contact at 26.5 s at our RIGHT_PARK.
STILL.watch: A still partner in the LOADING ZONE touches our RIGHT_PARK: ask it to sit in the corner.

CROSSER.label: CROSSER
CROSSER.auto: L-NoCross on WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX, or R-NoCross
init: Take whichever start it leaves free
L-NoCross: if no TIP 1: WAIT FOR PARTNER FIX; R-NoCross: if no TIP 2: WAIT FOR PARTNER. Never CROSS AND FIX IT
Endgame: PARK FIRST
ask: Which side do you start, and do you shoot your preloads right at the start?
Where are you at 10 s and 20 s, and where do you park?
CROSSER.sim: No stand-in: never seen as a partner. Its route needs video.
CROSSER.watch: Contact risk: it uses both ends of the field in AUTO.
